gaps.explanation: The schedule is 358,409 above the statement. Detail takes the business-type outflows from the Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Funds (p9, printed p46): 'Charges to appropriations' Electric 5,772,585 + Water 592,294 + Sewer 523,913 = Total business-type 6,888,792. These are budgetary-basis outflows: they leave out depreciation and include capital and debt payments. The statement figure is the accrual-basis Proprietary Funds statement (p7, printed p18): Total operating expenses 6,516,840 (including depreciation 339,508) + Interest expense 13,543 = 6,530,383. Both printed totals are correct on their own basis. No line is missing or duplicated, so there is nothing to fix.
